notes: הִוא is unrepresented: the ASV's subject is the fronted 'the land which ...', and rule 20 puts the supplied copula on the predicate אֶרֶץ rather than on an explicit subject pronoun, so no English word is left for it (rule 22).
The clause וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ מִקְנֶה is verbless, so the possessive לְ carries 'have' (rule 43) and the suffix keeps 'thy'.
